policy.title: About this App & Policy
policy.aboutText1: This app allows you to talk to the Bluesky bot, Zenkoitei Bot-tan (Bluesky Profile: bot-tan.suibari.com).
policy.aboutText2: Zenkoitei Bot-tan is a girl who loves to encourage everyone, designed by the developer. For more details, please visit her character page.
policy.aiText: This app uses generative AI (Gemini API). However, your input data is NOT used for AI training.
policy.historyText: Bluesky sign-in is performed securely via OAuth; your password is never transmitted to or stored on our servers. Only for followers, your chat history is saved in our database to resume chats. This history is private, never shared with others, and not used for AI training.
policy.privacyText: Please do not enter sensitive credentials such as passwords or credit card details into this application.
policy.disclaimerText: The developer does not guarantee the accuracy or safety of the AI-generated responses. The developer holds no responsibility for any issues, damages, or consequences resulting from the use of this application.
